Open Darkroom Session

In person

Photography Studio Monitors

Photography Class: Beginner + Intermediate

This darkroom practice session is for students who have taken darkroom classes at CAW before and are comfortable working independently.

Sessions are $30 each. To reserve a spot for a specific week, please contact the front desk at 203-562-4927. Payment can be made through the link below, over the phone, or in person at the front desk.

School Policies

Students who withdraw 48 hours prior to the first class are eligible for a refund or credit toward another class, less a $25 registration fee.
